description: This file defines a generic Java record named PagedResponse used as a minimal page-like response wrapper for endpoints in the shopizer gateway. It contains pagination metadata and content, designed to mimic Spring's Page structure without depending on Spring Data.

classes.name: PagedResponse
classes.description: A generic record class representing a paginated response with content and metadata, used for API responses.

methods.name: <constructor>
methods.description: Default constructor generated for the record, initializing content, number, size, totalElements, totalPages, first, last.
